in_sanskrit.name: Rasu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Juice, Essence
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rasu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rasu is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘rasa’, which means juice, essence or flavor. In Hindu mythology, Rasu is also considered a form of the goddess Lakshmi, who represents wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. It is also believed that the name Rasu can bring joy, happiness, and harmony to one's life.
